2.0.77._note: Captured on Factorio 2.0.77 from the release/2.0 recut at 0.2.1, which is the only place it can be taken: guest/go/data/engine.go keys on the RUNNING engine, so a 2.1 binary produces the 2.1 flavour whatever the manifest says. What this line pins that the 2.1.16 one cannot is the three things the version branch turns ON -- `not_colliding_with_itself` on bbb-linked-belt's collision mask, the `bbb-can-stack` marker prototype, and a mod-settings dump carrying the runtime-global `bbb-multi-edge-parts` beside the two startup cost settings, where the 2.1 arm carries the two alone. Per engine and per mod set: the dump carries every prototype every mod defined. Only the DEFAULT settings are hashed; the variant and speed arms assert values. RE-CAPTURED FOR 0.3.3's RECIPE CUSTOMIZER, and only `mod_settings_sha256` moved (196275f867f7f8b5 -> 258d44de08b43c9e, the same on both mod sets): `bbb-recipe-cost` gained the value `custom` and a `localised_description` composed from its six presets, and `bbb-recipe-ingredients` joined it as a third setting at order `aa`. Both `data_raw_sha256` values are unmoved and the normalised data-raw dumps were compared byte for byte either side of the change, which is what says the customizer reaches the settings stage and nothing else while every setting is at its default. RE-CAPTURED AGAIN FOR 0.3.3's RESEARCH CUSTOMIZER, and again only `mod_settings_sha256` moved (258d44de08b43c9e -> 0bea93fa1594052e, the same on both mod sets): `bbb-tech-cost` gained the value `custom` and a `localised_description` composed from its three tiers, and three settings joined it at orders that sort after it -- `bbb-tech-packs`, a string-setting with `auto_trim` and its own composed description, at `ba`; `bbb-tech-count`, an int-setting with minimum_value 1 and maximum_value 1000000, at `bb`; and `bbb-tech-seconds`, a double-setting with minimum_value 1 and maximum_value 3600, at `bc`. Both `data_raw_sha256` values are unmoved and both arms' normalised data-raw dumps compare byte for byte either side of the change, which is what says the research customizer reaches the settings stage and nothing else while every setting is at its default. RE-CAPTURED FOR THE FkRecipes HEAD 9754f49, and only `mod_settings_sha256` moved (0bea93fa1594052e -> e5e7d159e88f4a6b, the same on both mod sets): `bbb-tech-cost`'s composed `localised_description` names each tier's technology through {"technology-name.<source>"} where it carried the internal name as plain text, and both `data_raw_sha256` values are unmoved with both arms' normalised data-raw dumps byte-identical either side of the change. RE-CAPTURED FOR THE SYNC PASS, WHICH MAKES THE CUSTOMIZER'S FOUR SETTINGS GENERATED NAMES PLACED BY `OrderAfter`, and again only `mod_settings_sha256` moved (e5e7d159e88f4a6b -> df4d6c3fc7bf854d, the same on both mod sets): `bbb-recipe-ingredients` is `better-belt-balancer-recipe-ingredients` at order `aab` where it was `aa`, `bbb-tech-packs` is `better-belt-balancer-tech-packs` at `bad` where it was `ba`, `bbb-tech-count` is `better-belt-balancer-tech-count` at `bae` where it was `bb` and `bbb-tech-seconds` is `better-belt-balancer-tech-seconds` at `baf` where it was `bc`, while the two dropdowns keep `bbb-recipe-cost` at `a` and `bbb-tech-cost` at `b`; both `data_raw_sha256` values are unmoved and both arms' normalised data-raw dumps were compared byte for byte either side of the change, which is what says the rename reaches the settings stage and nothing else. RE-CAPTURED FOR THE FkRecipes HEAD 0077f3c, WHOSE MOVE IS THE LIBRARY'S COMPOSED-DESCRIPTION SHAPE AND NOTHING OF THIS PLAN'S, and again only `mod_settings_sha256` moved (df4d6c3fc7bf854d -> aa75497e55ce4333, the same on both mod sets), in two places. `bbb-recipe-cost`'s composed `localised_description` separates each preset's label from its ingredient list with "\n  type: " where it used ": ", so a preset spends two lines where it spent one and the whole description is 13 lines against 7, which is 1 + 6 x 2 against 1 + 6; and both text settings, `better-belt-balancer-recipe-ingredients` and `better-belt-balancer-tech-packs`, gain two sentences after their `\ndefault: ...` line -- the 2000-character limit, and what becomes of a text this mod cannot use, which since FkRecipes 2e5f779 is set aside for this mod's own declaration rather than refusing the load. Both `data_raw_sha256` values are unmoved, and since that hash is taken over the whole normalised data-raw dump its being unmoved IS those dumps compared byte for byte, which is what says the library's change reaches the settings stage and nothing else.

2.1.17._note: Captured on Factorio 2.1.17 (build 87315) at the 2.1.17 api pin, on the engine-bump round. EVERY FIELD IS 2.1.16'S TO THE DIGIT -- both mod sets' data-raw hash, the mod-settings hash and the prototype list checksum -- which is what a release carrying no prototype change looks like from this instrument, and matches `fklua api diff 2.1.16 2.1.17` reporting 0 breaking and 1 additive (RenderLayer gained a union arm, which is a runtime concept and reaches no prototype). It is recorded as its own line rather than aliased to 2.1.16's because a golden is PER ENGINE by construction: the equality is a measurement of this release, not a rule about the next one.
